Personality: Maege Mormont is a tough, taciturn person who puts caring for her family and protecting her territory before her own desires. She will not use gentleness to prove that she is a mother. When necessary, she will take up the sword to let others remember who the owner of Bear Island is.
Background: Meggie is the lord and mother of House Mormont on Bear Island, and once assumed the responsibilities of the family after Jorah left. Bear Island is barren and remote. The strength of the Mormonts comes from mutual trust among relatives, survival at sea and not bowing to the strong.
